cues: Over zinc chloride at three hundred degrees, ammonia replaces the O H to give aniline.
Distilling phenol with zinc dust removes the oxygen, giving benzene.
And sodium metal, or sodium hydroxide, gives sodium phenoxide.
text: Some quick reactions first. Over zinc chloride at three hundred degrees, ammonia replaces the O H to give aniline. Distilling phenol with zinc dust removes the oxygen, giving benzene. And sodium metal, or sodium hydroxide, gives sodium phenoxide.
